value.source_statement:
For every n≥0 and every S⊆Rn(n)×ℝ equipped with the maximum product norm, euclideanLift n sends S to an equal-dimensional set in WithLp 2 (Rn(n)×ℝ). This is the identity on underlying pairs and equips the target with the Euclidean product norm.
Closed basis type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (BasisObjects.Rn n × ℝ)),
  dimH (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n '' S) = dimH S
Prepared proof:
intro n S
exact YuiBasis.B005 (BasisObjects.Rn n × ℝ) (WithLp 2 (BasisObjects.Rn n × ℝ))
  (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (BasisObjects.Rn n) ℝ).symm S
value.context: Both factors are real normed spaces. prodContinuousLinearEquiv is a continuous linear equivalence from WithLp 2 (Rn(n)×ℝ) to the ordinary maximum-norm product. Its inverse has underlying map WithLp.toLp 2. ContinuousLinearEquiv.dimH_image, with scalar field ℝ, gives the displayed equality for every set and every natural n, without original H or measurability of S. No textbook result is assumed.
